name: prman
description: Help developers contribute to well-known open-source projects with Codex

interface.shortDescription: Meaningful PRs, one at a time.
interface.longDescription: PRman asks how many PRs an ordinary developer wants and for a target or contribution preferences, then automatically starts a Codex Goal and handles meaningful open-source contributions one at a time. It rejects low-value drive-by work, finds a suitable issue, lets Codex implement and test the change, challenge-reviews the final diff, shows a simple preview, asks for a separate confirmation, creates a Draft PR, follows CI, and repeats until the requested count is reached.
defaultPrompt: Find one meaningful Python issue and use a Goal to finish it, test it, review it, then ask before a Draft PR.
Help me fix this GitHub issue, test and challenge-review the change, then ask before creating a Draft PR.
